CA.rationale: Content (red) for candidate node is paired with a processing-origin (command_estimate) in the same candidate node/time.

COD.rationale: The current node n3 has an identified content (red), an explicit presentation (coordinate listing), and a distinct origin/status entry.

A.rationale: A processing/estimation origin (command_estimate) is explicitly associated with the candidate node's content, linking processing state to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify contents (red/blue) as sets of coordinates for named nodes/timepoints.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate) are recorded separately from the content coordinate listings, distinguishing content identity from status/source.

O.rationale: Coordinate lists explicitly specify how each content is presented/organized for nodes at current and candidate times.
